mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A crossing of the federal funds rate above 4.0% triggers a tightening cycle, increasing borrowing costs and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% but 20-day forward returns are not negative, or the crossing is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (GDPC1) alongside falling supply (INDPRO) indicates market overvaluation, prompting investors to sell ahead of corrections and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and INDPRO show the interaction but 20-day returns are not positive, or the pattern isn't sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment (PAYEMS) signals weakening labor market strength, prompting expectations of interest rate hikes and positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS rises above 5.0k but 5-day forward returns are not positive, or the rise isn't sustained.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL (inflation) and declines in FEDFUNDS (rate cuts) signal transitory inflation, fostering risk appetite and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS show the interaction but 20-day returns are not positive, or the pattern isn't followed.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a monthly drop in UNRATE below 5.5% signals labor market strength, attracting risk capital and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5.5% in a month
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, UNRATE falls below 5.5% but 20-day returns are not positive, or the regime isn't active.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in demand (GDPC1) coupled with a decline in supply (INDPRO) indicates market overvaluation, prompting investors to anticipate corrections and generate positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases while INDPRO decreases over 3 months
failure_condition: GDPC1 and INDPRO show the 3-month trend but 60-day returns are not positive, or the trend isn't sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in both the federal funds rate and CPIAUCSL (inflation) over 3 months signals monetary easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both decline for 3 months
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL decline for 3 months but 20-day returns are not positive, or the decline isn't sustained.
